result.summary: Logging a client supplied attachment miss at info is consistent with repo logging rules and changes no public behaviour. The claimed cause is not evidenced, and a possible contract gap (INBOUND author can be a different customer than the thread, but attachments are checked against the thread customer) goes uninvestigated.

problems.title: Possible API contract gap now silenced
problems.detail: INBOUND authors are not required to be the thread customer, yet attachments are validated against thread.customerId and rejected as 'not found'; clients uploading for the author customer hit this with no documented rule.

problems.title: Root cause asserted without evidence
problems.detail: entity_not_found/attachment covers both a missing id and another customer's attachment; the PR shows no Datadog logs proving which branch fired.

problems.title: Downgrade keyed on error shape, not source
problems.detail: Any future entity_not_found/attachment from the Nango sync path would also drop to info; today that path converts not found to skips, so the risk is latent.

problems.title: Decision logic untested
problems.detail: Tests cover the recorder option and existing API behaviour, not failResolvedAttachments choosing info vs error.

result.betterFix: Keep the log change, but confirm in Datadog which branch fires; if clients upload for the message author, either validate attachments against the author customer or document the thread customer requirement and return a specific error instead of not_found.
